result.keywords: This study presents a field-based analysis of bioluminescent fish movement patterns across tidal estuaries, combining acoustic tagging, spectral water sampling, and spatial interpolation to map nightly migration corridors. We examine how salinity gradients, moon phase, and suspended sediment influence route selection and aggregation behavior in lantern fish populations. The work emphasizes ecological surveying and environmental modeling rather than robotics, microfluidics, or urban sensing.
result.title: Harmonic Cartography of Estuarine Lantern Fish Migration in Nocturnal Bays.
